cards.title: Night Clerk
cards.blurb: A box with no label comes down the chute at 2:14 a.m.: the file on a woman who vanished in 1979. Read it, hire clerks, pin the cards to a wall, then post the clerks on the night's watches. Each door you open retires what you did before it.

shots.beat: Phase I: eight clerks reading the box
